answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds bind each identity to a staked collateral vault whose marginal cost rises with issuance, while subgame-perfect punishment matrices impose slashing penalties calibrated by zero-knowledge verifiable delay to make Sybil multiplication yield a strictly negative expected utility. So the unique strict Nash equilibrium converges as agents internalize the lantern of commitment and the echo of recursive threats.
